defect.before: Repeat disclosure required chevron targeting, inherited the same accessibility ID onto child controls, and the window-wide Space handler could complete the selected task while Repeat owned focus.

Focused task-list Space completes original and creates exactly one next-day successor with count 2; native Command-Z restores original Jan 3 plan, Jan 6 deadline, count 3 and estimate 25.
Focused task-list Return opens exact task editor; Escape clears task selection and inspector.
Command-N bounded capture preview visually wraps; saved Jan 3 2028 plan, Jan 5 recurrence end, 3 occurrences, Jan 6 independent deadline and 25-minute estimate persist across normal relaunch.
Quick reminder capture saves -30-minute relative reminder, +2-hour fixed instant, tomorrow 09:00 fixed instant, plus workspace default at planned time.
Independent reminder every! day rejects Save; every 2 weeks on Monday and Friday for 5 occurrences accepts Save.
Repeating reminder survives Cancel editing, clearing task plan and full process relaunch; fixed reminders persist and relative reminders explicitly await a planned date.
Deleting only the independent repeating reminder persists through second normal relaunch; all four other reminder specs are unchanged.
visualCaveat: Native time-picker AX reported 16.56 while the UTC-environment picker visibly displayed 15.56. Inline screenshot, saved schedule time and next-occurrence summary all agree on 15:56; this is not recorded as a time-setting defect. No screenshot file was retained.
